products: Strategic Role: India's primary food-security clearinghouse, procurement engine, and bulk storage corridor.
catchment: Catchment Areas: Sangrur, Ludhiana, Patiala, Bathinda (Punjab); Karnal, Kaithal, Kurukshetra, Sirsa (Haryana); Meerut, Aligarh, Bulandshahr, Mathura (Western UP).

paragraphs.text: 1. Northern Grain Buffer & Bulk Storage Corridor (Punjab, Haryana & Western UP)
Strategic Role: India's primary food-security clearinghouse, procurement engine, and bulk storage corridor.

Key Facilities: Large automated steel silo complexes (Adani Agri Logistics at Moga, Kaithal; private concessionaires in Ludhiana, Barnala), automated roller flour mills in Delhi-NCR and Ludhiana, and FCI railhead terminals dispatching grain rakes to food-deficit states.
Catchment Areas: Sangrur, Ludhiana, Patiala, Bathinda (Punjab); Karnal, Kaithal, Kurukshetra, Sirsa (Haryana); Meerut, Aligarh, Bulandshahr, Mathura (Western UP).

processing.name: Malwa–Central Value-Addition & Durum Processing Hub (Madhya Pradesh)
products: Strategic Role: The quality, durum, and premium branded atta capital of India.
catchment: Catchment Areas: Sehore, Vidisha, Raisen, Hoshangabad (Narmada basin); Ujjain, Dewas, Dhar, Khargone (Malwa plateau); border arrivals from the Hadoti belt in Rajasthan (Kota, Jhalawar).

paragraphs.text: 2. Malwa–Central Value-Addition & Durum Processing Hub (Madhya Pradesh)
Strategic Role: The quality, durum, and premium branded atta capital of India.

Key Facilities: Automated color-sorting plants, branded consumer atta mills (ITC Choupals, Adani Wilmar, Patanjali), and modern durum pasta/semolina extrusion plants centered around Indore, Dewas, Pithampur, Ujjain, and Bhopal.
Catchment Areas: Sehore, Vidisha, Raisen, Hoshangabad (Narmada basin); Ujjain, Dewas, Dhar, Khargone (Malwa plateau); border arrivals from the Hadoti belt in Rajasthan (Kota, Jhalawar).

products: Strategic Role: Grain-deficit coastal and metropolitan zones that process northern wheat into industrial flour for baking, noodles, and confectionery.
catchment: Catchment Areas: Raw material is supplied via long-haul freight trains (goods rakes) sourced through FCI's Open Market Sale Scheme (OMSS) or direct private trade purchases from Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Punjab mandis.

paragraphs.text: 3. Peninsular Consumption & Port Milling Centers (Maharashtra, TN, Karnataka)
Strategic Role: Grain-deficit coastal and metropolitan zones that process northern wheat into industrial flour for baking, noodles, and confectionery.
Key Centers: Navi Mumbai / Vashi (JNPT port corridor), Chennai (Royapuram/Ambattur mill clusters), and Bengaluru industrial outskirts.

Catchment Areas: Raw material is supplied via long-haul freight trains (goods rakes) sourced through FCI's Open Market Sale Scheme (OMSS) or direct private trade purchases from Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Punjab mandis.

protection.name: Yellow Rust / Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis f. sp. tritici)
protection.geography: NW Plains & Hill Zones (Severe in Punjab, Haryana, Tarai UP, HP, J&K)
protection.impact: Bright yellow powdery pustules (urediniospores) arranged in parallel linear stripes along leaf veins; leaves turn yellow and dry up; spores easily dust onto fingers; blights entire fields under cool, moist weather, reducing yield by 30–70%.
protection.passage: Wheat — source table 93, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Brown Rust / Leaf Rust (Puccinia triticina)
protection.geography: Central & Peninsular India (MP, Maharashtra, Gujarat, South UP)
protection.impact: Round-to-oval orange-brown pustules scattered irregularly across the leaf blade (not in distinct stripes); causes premature leaf senescence and reduces 1,000-grain weight.
protection.passage: Wheat — source table 93, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Loose Smut (Ustilago tritici)
protection.impact: Every spikelet in the infected earhead is converted into a black, powdery mass of fungal chlamydospores enclosed in a delicate membrane; membrane bursts at heading, leaving a naked, bare, black rachis.
protection.passage: Wheat — source table 93, row 4. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Karnal Bunt (Tilletia indica / Neovossia indica)
protection.geography: Northern & Sub-Mountainous Belts (Punjab, Haryana, Tarai UP)
protection.impact: Only a few individual grains per earhead are partially converted into a black powdery mass of teliospores; infected grains emit a foul, fishy odor due to the volatile compound trimethylamine; zero tolerance in international export grain shipments.
protection.passage: Wheat — source table 93, row 5. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Termites (Odontotermes obesus, Microtermes obesi)
protection.geography: Sandy Loam & Rainfed Wheat Belts (MP, Rajasthan, South Haryana)
protection.impact: Worker termites feed on underground roots and the stem base; plants dry up, turn pale yellow, and pull out easily with a light tug; dead plants show hollow, earth-filled stems.
protection.passage: Wheat — source table 93, row 6. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Khapra Beetle & Lesser Grain Borer (Trogoderma granarium, Rhyzopertha dominica)
protection.geography: All Mandi Depots & Central Pool Silos
protection.impact: Khapra beetle larvae feed on the grain embryo and hollow out seeds, leaving behind cast larval skins and hair; creates fine flour dust; major quarantine pest for export grain.
protection.passage: Wheat — source table 93, row 7. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.
